# The Thomlinson Consultancy

> The Thomlinson Consultancy offers mindset coaching, business growth coaching, executive leadership coaching, business masterminds and speaker training, led by coach, mentor and international keynote speaker Marcus Thomlinson and a growing team of coaches. Everything is built on iCan Thinking, the positive-thinking method, app and community created by Marcus (icanthinking.com). Based in Brighton & Hove and London, and online. It is coaching and education, not therapy.

The brand is written "The Thomlinson Consultancy" (with an h in Thomlinson). iCan Thinking is written with a small "i" and capital "C".

## Key pages
- [Home](https://thethomlinsonconsultancy.com/): overview of services and the iCan Thinking method
- [The iCan Thinking method](https://thethomlinsonconsultancy.com/the-ican-thinking-method/): See it, Feel it, Believe it, then do it every day
- [Mindset Coaching](https://thethomlinsonconsultancy.com/mindset-coaching/): clarity, confidence, calm and fulfilment, one to one or in a group
- [Business Growth Coaching](https://thethomlinsonconsultancy.com/business-growth-coaching/): Business Health Check and the 12 month iCan Grow programme
- [Executive Leadership Coaching](https://thethomlinsonconsultancy.com/executive-leadership-coaching/): the Top 10 Mindsets of Great Leaders
- [Business Mastermind](https://thethomlinsonconsultancy.com/business-mastermind/): weekly groups of up to 12 business owners
- [Speaker Training Day](https://thethomlinsonconsultancy.com/the-secret-storyteller-public-speaker-training-day/): a one-day public speaking course
- [Meet the coaches](https://thethomlinsonconsultancy.com/coaches/): Superpower Cards for each coach
- [Reviews](https://thethomlinsonconsultancy.com/reviews/): testimonials from clients and event organisers
- [About Marcus Thomlinson](https://thethomlinsonconsultancy.com/about-marcus/): biography, speaking and keynote information
- [Contact and booking](https://thethomlinsonconsultancy.com/contact-and-booking/): book a free discovery call
